reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope tracing, step blockade/restoration and proposed biochemical reconstitution.

checks.reason: No prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation with condition transfer before execution.
The core arms lack sham handling/wash and inactive enzyme controls for the primary interruption/restoration route.
Lists tissue preparation alternatives without selecting or resolving an identifiable source/system and integrity-qualified assay route.
No quantitative buffer/cofactor recipe or concrete calibration-to-choice procedure; label position and time selection remain insufficiently specified.
A lower-bound isotope recovery target is not full calibration: no quantitative isotope/matrix reference accuracy, upper closure limit and validated quench/recovery failure rule.
No executable background/below-limit or missing-pool handling and complete labelled plus unlabelled carbon accounting for the quantitative endpoint.
Aliquots are not independently prepared biological replicates; no justified independent-unit precision or power plan.
Treats activity without added substrate as invalid rather than retaining and quantifying genuine endogenous-fuel metabolism.
Statistical significance is invoked without a defined model, preparation-level uncertainty and multiple-contrast handling.
Selecting inhibitor dose from oxygen suppression and validating washout by resumed respiration do not assay the actual target, neighboring steps or residual inhibitor independently.
No bounded parameter exploration, objective dose/time selection and lock before confirmation.
Failure checks such as verifying inhibitor penetration are not paired with an actual penetration/target assay and ordered diagnostic repair/retest.
No refrozen repaired protocol with fresh independent confirmation or protection against tuning through biological nonresponses.

CTR greater than one does not uniquely establish multiple cycles: a multi-carbon molecule can release multiple CO2 in one pass, and allosteric activation can increase substrate oxidation. Label entry into X is not proof of return/regeneration.
An artificial matrix with unspecified validated enzymes is not an operational purified component inventory with omission/restoration and contamination qualification.
No sample/raw-data/code/model/version/settings audit trail.
